Container.Name: discord-stream-bot
Container.Overview: Joins one Discord voice channel and plays an audio stream (e.g. an Icecast radio stream) there, but only while somebody is listening. Configured only through environment variables. No ports, no commands, no privileged intents.

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot page).

Config.Name: Voice channel ID
Config.Description: ID of the voice channel the bot joins (Developer Mode - right click channel - Copy Channel ID).

Config.Name: Stream URL
Config.Description: URL of the audio stream to play, e.g. http://deadair:80/live.mp3

Config.Name: Idle timeout (s)
Config.Description: Seconds without listeners in the channel before the stream stops (the bot stays in the channel, silent). 0 = always play.
